variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Meat and animal derivatives 80 (fresh turkey 30%), minerals.

Analytical constituents: Crude Protein: 7.5%, Crude fibre: 0.5%, Crude fat: 5.5%, Crude ash: 2.3%, Moisture: 80.0%.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES / kg: Vitamin A (retinyl acetate) 2500 IU, Vitamin D3 140 IU, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl acetate 3a700i) 5 mg.
variants.feeding_instructions: Recommended daily feeding intakes for adult dogs (see table) may be split into 2 meals. Serve at room temperature. Once opened, keep refrigerated and consume within 2 days. Do not open the package if it is damaged or swollen. Store in a cool and dry place. Fresh and clean water should be available at all times. Dog food only, not suitable for human consumption.
